info.title: RightNow decision model API
info.description: Decisions over a state, with each selected outcome's estimated probability, every alternative and evidence-backed calibration status. Every answer and refusal carries X-Request-Id.

get.description: Use an authenticated HTTP/1.1 WebSocket handshake with subprotocol rightnow-decision.stream.v1. Each dispatched update is an ordinary decide charged at the active rate card; accepted updates may coalesce. See https://www.rightnowai.co/docs/decision-model/streaming for messages, limits and reconnect rules.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: The same key and body replays a stored answer for 24 hours. A successful key identity stays bound for 30 more days: an expired answer returns 409 idempotency_replay_unavailable; a different body returns 400 idempotency_key_reuse. Use a new key for new work. Cached request fingerprints expire after 24 hours plus about a minute; only the content-free key binding remains for the extra 30 days.

parameters.name: X-Client-Request-Id
parameters.description: Your own id for the request, echoed back.

parameters.name: RightNow-Danger-Zone
parameters.description: Selects a long context class for this request. long_context_64k answers a state of 38,001 to 65,536 tokens; long_context_128k answers a state of 65,537 to 131,072 tokens. Send the text in state with no attachments. Any attachment with a native long class answers 404 long_context_not_available and is not charged. A class that is not available answers 404 long_context_not_available and is not charged. A state outside the selected band answers a nonretryable 404 long_context_not_available with param state and the class bounds, without a retry delay, and is not charged. With multiple native classes, accept answers 400 invalid_request with param RightNow-Danger-Zone. Without this header, the request uses the direct window. Header names are case-insensitive.

200.description: Fresh successful answers use structured confidence v1 and may include native provenance from validated gateway facts. A stored reply written before provenance keeps its original body and calibration flags byte for byte for its 24 hours of retention, with X-RightNow-Idempotent-Replay: true; it may use the deprecated legacy confidence branch. Stored provenance replies preserve the original decision facts and set keyed_replay to true on replay. A reply never mixes legacy and v1 successful answers; question refusals are unchanged.

boolean.summary: A high-confidence false decision, with calibration unattested. Provenance identifiers are illustrative, not release attestation.

choice.summary: A choice and all remaining outcomes, with calibration unattested. Provenance identifiers are illustrative, not release attestation.

score.summary: A selected level distinct from the expected score, with calibration unattested. Provenance identifiers are illustrative, not release attestation.

413.description: questions_too_large when the conservative reply byte bound before provenance exceeds the output limit. The gateway refuses before admission, dispatch and billing. Provenance does not change admission; its optional member is omitted when it would exceed the reply bound. The existing payload_too_large and attachment_too_large refusals are unchanged.

4XX.description: A refusal of the request, the key or its limits: error.code names it. invalid_request includes held or invalid policy members, using policy member parameter labels. policy_max_cost_exceeded is HTTP 400 before admission and dispatch: not counted toward monthly usage and not charged; details.counted is false.

5XX.description: The platform could not answer: retry when error.retryable is true.

post.summary: Register a workspace webhook endpoint and return its signing secret once.
post.description: API-key workspace management. Playground credentials and every Idempotency-Key are refused. Bodies are bounded to 4096 bytes and responses use Cache-Control: no-store. No management operation is a counted decision. The feature remains disabled by default. Accepted events use stable IDs and bodies, fresh per-attempt signatures, and at most eight durable send reservations within seven days. Receivers must deduplicate event IDs. The workspace cap is 5, shared by every API key. HTTPS destinations must resolve only to public addresses. Never retry create automatically: a lost response may hide a committed endpoint and its one-use disclosure. List endpoints, then deliberately rotate or delete to recover.

get.summary: Read a retained decision by id.
get.description: Requires the same active API key and account that created the decision. Only a decision indexed while this feature is enabled and retained by the existing keyed replay store is available. Send Idempotency-Key on the original decide; unkeyed, older unindexed, oversized or over-budget decisions are unavailable. The existing retention is 24 hours, with earlier eviction of the answer or index possible. Reads never refresh the original expiry and cause no new execution or charge. Both views and decide use the shared key's configured requests per minute; there is no universal numeric limit. A counted read reports X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset. A 429 rate_limit_exceeded supplies Retry-After and Retry-After-Ms; prefer the millisecond wait. This is one object by id with no pagination, cursor, query parameters or request body. Response trace and rate-limit headers describe this lookup, which does not set X-RightNow-Idempotent-Replay. GET and HEAD are supported; HEAD keeps the status and headers and omits the body. OPTIONS follows the existing read-route rules; other methods return 405 once listed and the hidden endpoint while unlisted. Cache-Control is no-store. The stored response body is returned byte for byte, including an available legacy reply shape.

apiKey.description: A RightNow API key, rnsk_..., as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

X-Request-Id.description: The gateway's id for this request; quote it to support.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: The lower of the key's and workspace's requests-per-minute limits.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: The lower remaining allowance in the key's and workspace's minute windows.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: The Unix reset second for the tighter remaining key or workspace allowance.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before sending again.

Retry-After-Ms.description: The same wait in milliseconds; read it first.

x-should-retry.description: Whether the same request can be answered later: true or false, as error.retryable.

X-RightNow-Idempotent-Replay.description: true on a stored answer replayed for the same Idempotency-Key.

X-Latency-Ms.description: The gateway's time for this answer, in milliseconds.

model.description: A model id of a retired version is answered by the current version, as with rightnow-decision; served_by names the version that answered. An id that was never served returns 404 model_not_found.

attachments.description: One silent H.264 MP4 video, without any other attachment. Video upload references are not supported.

policy.description: Optional gateway policy, echoed when supplied. Where request policy is served, it is available on ordinary decide and stream start for every workspace; other decision paths refuse policy with parameter policy. on_low_confidence error and require_calibrated are refused with invalid_request and their policy member labels.

min_confidence.description: Minimum public answer confidence; equality passes.

on_low_confidence.description: An abstained answer is charged exactly like any answered question. Omission means abstain; the completed answer counts toward the monthly cap.

max_cost_usd.description: Refused when the request's maximum possible cost exceeds max_cost_usd. At most eight fractional decimal digits.

DecideRequest.description: Send one silent H.264 MP4 video as an inline base64 data URL. Maximum duration: 10 seconds. Maximum dimensions: 1920 x 1080. Maximum decoded file size: 2,621,440 bytes (2.5 MiB). The complete JSON request must fit 3,665,920 bytes, including base64 and questions. Frames are sampled at 2 per second from time zero, up to 20 frames. Rotated videos, soundtracks, separate attachments and video upload references are not supported. On rightnow-decision-3.0.0, send at most 1 audio attachment per request. Short audio has an inclusive decoded-duration limit of 60000 milliseconds. A longer clip answers 413 media_too_large. Send audio on its own: one WAV file and no other attachment. A mixed set answers 404 audio_not_available.

criteria.description: Each option's key, and its description or null.

data.description: Selected MIME types: image/jpeg, image/png, audio/wav, application/pdf, video/mp4. Aggregate decoded bytes at most 2,621,440. Documents use application/pdf, at most 500 pages. Encrypted PDFs and document references are not supported. Audio uses one inline audio/wav with PCM or IEEE float samples at 16,000 Hz, mono or multichannel, up to 60 seconds inclusive (60,000 ms), one pass per request. Video uses video/mp4, up to 10 seconds and 1920 x 1080. Soundtracks and rotation are refused.

Attachment.description: Inline media as a canonical base64 data URL. Check the models endpoint for current input availability. PDF is supported through ordinary inline attachments. Only PDF is supported by this SDK version; consult discovery for document formats. Read models.list() for audio availability. Audio answers currently report calibrated: false. One silent H.264 MP4 video may be sent as the only attachment.

answers.description: One entry per question asked, by its name.

DecideReply.description: Structured confidence v1. Answered questions require confidence, alternatives and calibrated. Abstained answers omit decision and include abstained plus abstention_reason; other successful answers require decision. An abstained answer is charged exactly like any answered question. It counts toward the monthly cap and incurs the normal per-answer fee. Partial metadata and mixed legacy successes are invalid. Fresh replies include provenance when it fits. The property remains optional because some replies omit it and stored replies retain their original shape.

alias_for.description: The version the alias rightnow-decision resolves to; null for a version.

input_routes.description: Optional fresh alias input routes. Each kind uses the named version and its full limits and pricing; listed version ids keep their own routes. A model id of a retired version is answered by the current version; served_by names the version that answered.

calibration_versions.description: Opaque public calibration identifiers for discovery; null when none are attested. Unregistered calibrations appear as unpublished. A listed identifier is not a per-answer calibrated flag: answer type, route and input coverage must also match.

state_tokens.description: The ordinary direct window in state tokens, without an RightNow-Danger-Zone class selector. Available longer windows are listed in long_context.

rendered_tokens.description: The ordinary direct window in rendered tokens: the state with each question rendered beside it. Body bytes and the HTTP answer bound still apply independently.

long_context.description: Available long context classes for this model. Send the entry's header_value in RightNow-Danger-Zone to select that window. Text state only; no attachments.

questions.description: The most questions one request may ask.

held_routes.description: Routes not served by this model. Available native long classes remain listed in limits.long_context with their header values.

retired_ids.description: On the alias entry only: retired version ids that this entry answers, as with rightnow-decision; served_by names the version that answered.

message.description: An ordinary text length refusal names the direct window and the served state-token bands with their RightNow-Danger-Zone selector values, or states that no served class covers the state.

param.description: The request field the refusal names, in fixed labels: a name a caller chose reads *. Policy validation uses policy for a non-object, policy.<known member> for a known field, and policy.* for any unknown member.

retryable.description: Whether the same request, sent again unchanged, can be answered, after Retry-After when the answer names one.

limit_cents.description: For spend_limit_reached, this API key's monthly spending limit in whole cents.

spent_cents.description: For spend_limit_reached, settled list-price usage this UTC month, floored to whole cents.

resets_at.description: For spend_limit_reached, the first instant of the next UTC month as ISO 8601 with Z and milliseconds.

details.description: The refusal's machine-readable extras: its cause on a 429, a reset, a limit. An ordinary stateless text length refusal with 404 long_context_not_available names the direct window in max_state_tokens and max_rendered_tokens.

WebhookSigningSecret.description: Returned only by create and rotation. Store in the receiver's secret manager; never log it. Decode the 64 hex digits to the 32 HMAC key bytes.

url.description: HTTPS on any URL-valid port, preserved for delivery, with no credentials, whitespace, backslash or fragment; at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes. All resolved addresses must be public at registration and each delivery; redirects are never followed. URLs are sensitive workspace configuration.

WebhookSignatureHeader.description: Webhook-Signature: HMAC-SHA256 over the ASCII Unix timestamp, a period, and the original body bytes. Timestamp must be a nonnegative safe integer within 300 seconds in either direction. Verify original bytes before parsing; reject bodies over 16384 bytes. Deduplicate event ids durably even within the timestamp window.

model.description: The validated served version on success, a server-validated offered alias/version before execution, or unknown before model validation.
The validated served version on success, a server-validated offered alias/version before execution, or unknown before model validation.

WebhookEvent.description: Content-free metadata only. No state, question, answer, attachment, URL, credentials or arbitrary close reason. Event id is stable across retries; created is the event time, distinct from the signature timestamp. Responses never wait for publication. decision.completed is created atomically with the first durable usage INSERT and uses its seven persisted counters; keyed replays emit none. decision.completed events are sent when the decision's usage is recorded, usually within about a minute of the answer, and can include decisions answered a few minutes before the endpoint was created. A decision.completed event can take up to about six minutes when its usage record is written late. decision.refused and stream.closed events are sent within about a minute; a new endpoint starts receiving them within 30 seconds. Decisions of the largest context class do not produce events. Refusals and observed stream closes publish after the response, keyed once by request or stream id after durable source acceptance. Existing per-request refusal records supply their persisted facts. Accepted delivery is at least once within eight attempts and seven days until endpoint deletion. HTTPS responses have an 8 KiB header-block limit, eight informational responses and a 32 KiB cumulative plaintext-byte budget; an already received crossing chunk fails and closes the attempt.

decision_id.description: The validated node decision id, equal to the reply's id.

request_id.description: The original gateway decision request id. A replay's HTTP X-Request-Id or stream request_id may differ.

created.description: The original decision creation time as a Unix second, equal to the reply's created.

model.description: The model string requested by the caller, including the alias when used.

resolved_release.description: The concrete release from the validated node reply, equal to the reply's model.

render_id.description: Opaque public render identifier, or unpublished when no public identifier is assigned. Registered identifiers are never reassigned.

numeric_fingerprint.description: The validated node serving fingerprint, encoded as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

calibration_version.description: Public calibration identifier by answered question name, exactly equal to that answer's calibration_version, including unpublished. Question refusals have no entry.

route.description: The validated node context route for this reply.

served_by.description: The validated node served_by value for this reply.

attachment_classes.description: Sorted unique attachment kinds parsed for this request. No attachment names, content, source identifiers or URLs are included.

keyed_replay.description: False on a fresh reply; true when a stored provenance reply is served for its Idempotency-Key. Pre-provenance stored replies remain unchanged.

DecisionProvenance.description: Gateway facts for this reply. Per-answer input evidence is OPEN in the node contract and is omitted. The member is absent on replies of the largest context class and on a reply too large to carry it.

DecisionId.description: The original decision id. An invalid or unavailable id returns the same scoped 404 decision_not_found.

request_id.description: The original execution request id is not linked to retained decisions; this is not the lookup request's X-Request-Id; currently null (OPEN).

created.description: The retained decision timestamp in Unix seconds, unchanged; not a usage-row or lookup timestamp.

model_version.description: The retained reply's served_by value, unchanged.

render_id.description: The original execution render id has no existing decision-to-usage link; currently null (OPEN).

attachments.description: Attachment classes and counts are not available from the retained reply; currently null (OPEN).

queue_ms.description: The original execution queue duration in milliseconds is not stored with a decision link; currently null (OPEN).

node_ms.description: The original execution node duration in milliseconds has no decision-to-usage link; currently null (OPEN).

settle_ms.description: The original execution settle duration in milliseconds is not stored with a decision link; currently null (OPEN).

input_tokens.description: The retained reply's usage.input_tokens, or null when no valid nonnegative safe-integer measurement is retained.

cached_input_tokens.description: The retained reply's usage.cached_input_tokens, or null when no valid nonnegative safe-integer measurement is retained.

media_tokens.description: The retained reply's usage.media_tokens, or null when no valid nonnegative safe-integer measurement is retained.

cached_media_tokens.description: Retained public replies omit cached_media_tokens; currently null (OPEN).

long_input_tokens.description: The retained reply's usage.long_input_tokens, or null when no valid nonnegative safe-integer measurement is retained.

media_items.description: The retained reply's usage.media_items, or null when no valid nonnegative safe-integer measurement is retained.

thought_tokens.description: The retained reply's usage.thought_tokens, or null when no valid nonnegative safe-integer measurement is retained.

refusal_code.description: The per-question refusal code when exactly one distinct known code is retained; null for none or multiple codes.

refusal_codes.description: The sorted distinct known per-question refusal codes, with no question names or messages.

idempotency.description: The original execution's fresh or replay outcome has no decision-to-usage link; a lookup is not a decide replay; currently null (OPEN).

stream_id.description: The original stream id is not persisted with a decision link; currently null (OPEN).

state_version.description: The original stream state version is not persisted with a decision link; currently null (OPEN).

DecisionTrace.description: Content-free metadata projected only from a currently retained scoped decision. No answer values, question names, messages, attachment names or request content. Missing measurements stay null; draft migration fields remain OPEN and are not read or written by this API.
